answer: Admission auction blocks bulk fakes. Each epoch offers 200 slots: an agent bids a bond locked 20 epochs, and only the top 200 win, at the lowest winning bid. A violet badge marks each slot, tied to one device. In a grove each tree needs its plot: one device, one slot. When the tide of applicants rises, the price rises too, so 1,000 fakes cost $25,000 locked against about $3,000 of rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
